properties.name: Downtown
properties.info: The central core: Financial District, waterfront and the dense grid south of Bloor.

properties.name: Midtown
properties.info: Bloor to roughly Eglinton: the Annex, Yonge & St. Clair, Davisville.

properties.name: Uptown
properties.info: Around and north of Yonge & Eglinton up to the 401.

properties.name: West End
properties.info: Old Toronto west of Bathurst: Parkdale, the Junction, Roncesvalles, Little Italy.

properties.name: East End
properties.info: Old Toronto east of the Don: Riverdale, Leslieville, the Danforth, the Beaches.
